ipeds_ef.title: IPEDS Fall Enrollment 2023 (EF2023A): undergraduate total and U.S. nonresident headcount

stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2024 entering class; 80% admitted per College Navigator). EMU's 2025-2026 Common Data Set (emich.edu/irim) is blocked to automated access by a bot challenge, so it could not be read. Enrolled is full- plus part-time first-time students (1,621 full-time). Students who sent test scores: 1,123 SAT (68%) and 78 ACT (5%). International applicant counts, GPA and SAT total are not included in these figures. College Navigator shows U.S. nonresidents at about 5% of undergraduates (rounded), so the number of international undergraduates is not shown. Undergraduate enrollment is 10,470 (fall 2024).

cost.notes: College Navigator estimated expenses for full-time beginning undergraduates, 2024-25: one tuition and fees figure is listed for all students (EMU states it does not charge international undergraduates non-resident tuition); on-campus food and housing
